content.short: A progressive DEX for the Cardano Ecosystem, merging next-generation DEX capabilities with NFTfi.
content.description:
CSWAP DEX was born from a grassroots movement and community-driven passion. On the CSWAP DEX platform, there will be interesting opportunities unavailable elsewhere. Our innovative approach to decentralized finance will delight users.

The CSWAP DEX financial platform will be fully decentralized and trustless, featuring cutting-edge, Plutus V2 smart contract integration. We intend to provide a seamless user experience for all major Cardano wallets. Yoroi, Nami, Eternl, Flint, and Gerowallet have already been integrated.

Our NFTfi experience will allow holders to utilize their Cardano NFTs (CNFTs) like never before. We want to be the first DEX in the world to treat NFTs as the tokens they are. Harnessing the power of our AMM, combined with proprietary technology around NFT lending automation, we aim to break new ground in our space.

While the CSWAP DEX platform will be first available on web, we plan on releasing a mobile app for iOS and Android sometime after the DEX release. Members on our team have world class experience developing mobile apps for Global Fortune 500 companies.

We believe in transparent business practices and an engaged product development lifecycle. The CSWAP community is part of the team. We plan on working with our community as part of an agile/iterative development process. Together we will create tremendous value for the Cardano Ecosystem.
